fields.name: Special_Request_Text
fields.fieldText:
Special Response Required!


Your Shipping Quote requires a special rate. Joey Price and the LTL Team have been notified of your request and will update your opportunity with the proper shipping amounts ASAP. If you do not hear back from them within the hour, please reach out!


You can NOT submit a deal for shipping or submit for approval until this shipping quote is received!

fields.name: SystemSelectionHelp
fields.fieldText:
Shipping Category Key:

Pickup = Customer is picking up the equipment

Customer Account = We are shipping on the customer's account or on their behalf

Standard Dock-to-Dock = Standard Dock-To-Dock Shipping, no special considerations

Standard White-Glove = With lift-gate, debris removal & inside delivery

Enhanced White-Glove = Saturday delivery, two-man lift, etc.


System Type Key:

Small Crate = Mindray Console System

Standard Crate = All GE Ultrasounds, Used Mindray, Zonare, Samsung, All Carts, Non-Epiq Philips Systems

Large Crate = Philips Epiq Systems, Siemens Systems

Specialty Shipment = C-Arms, CT, X-Ray, MR, Other Medical Equipment, etc.

Thank You!
